def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    read(Path(__file__))
    started = time.time()
    read(Path(__file__))
    for p in [Path(C.__file__), Path(C.pcbtext.__file__), Path(S.overlay_tool.__file__), Path(S.overlay_tool.base.__file__), S.CONTROLLED]:
        read(p)
    census = json.loads(read(HERE / 'current-di-fault-routes-r1/current-source-policy.json'))
    parts = json.loads(read(BASE / 'measure/r07-four-fag-shared/partitions.json'))
    g = geometry()
    reserved = json.loads(read(C06 / 'alternate-r07/reserved-r07.json'))
    dru = read(C06 / 'alternate-r07/reserve/board.kicad_dru').decode()
    exemptions = {}
    for line in dru.splitlines():
        m = re.match('\\(rule "(RESERVE_KEEPOUT_[^"]+)" \\(condition "(.*)"\\) \\(constraint disallow track via\\)\\)', line.strip())
        if m:
            exemptions[m[1]] = {S.norm(n) for n in re.findall("A\\.NetName != '([^']*)'", m[2])}
    print('Building fresh exact-annulus geometry model', flush=True)
    Model = exact_model_class()
    model = Model(g, reserved, exemptions)
    refs = {}
    anchor = model.pads['J11001.2#0']
    refstats = {}
    for layer in ['In1.Cu', 'In4.Cu']:
        fill = unary_union([r['shape'] for r in model.records[layer] if r['kind'] == 'fill' and r['net'] == '/LOGIC_GND'])
        own = [r['shape'] for r in model.records[layer] if r.get('net') == '/LOGIC_GND' and r['kind'] in ('pad', 'track', 'via')]
        conductive = unary_union([fill] + own)
        a = unary_union(S.poly(anchor['layers'][layer]))
        pieces = [conductive] if conductive.geom_type == 'Polygon' else list(conductive.geoms)
        anchored = unary_union([p for p in pieces if p.intersects(a)])
        refs[layer] = fill.intersection(anchored)
        refstats[layer] = {'source_pad': 'J11001.2#0', 'source_uuid': anchor['uuid'], 'source_connected_fill_area_mm2': refs[layer].area}
    print('Fresh source references ready', flush=True)
    candidates = []
    excluded = []
    clock = re.compile('(CLK|SCLK|SCK|XTAL|OSC|USB|HDMI|MDI|_SW$|PHASE|BOOT|VREF|DVDT|ILIM|AGND|_COM$)', re.I)
    for row in census['rows']:
        net = row['net']
        n = S.norm(net)
        if row['category'] != 'ordinary_digital_catalog' or g['domains_normalized'].get(n) != 'DOM_LOGIC' or clock.search(n):
            continue
        groups = parts['nets'][net]
        shapes = [unary_union([p for pid in gr for layer in ['F.Cu', 'B.Cu'] for p in S.poly(model.pads[pid]['layers'].get(layer, []))]) for gr in groups]
        best = min(((a.distance(b), i, j) for i, a in enumerate(shapes) for j, b in enumerate(shapes) if i < j))
        candidates.append((best[0], net, best[1], best[2]))
    results = []
    accepted = []
    for distance, net, gi, gj in sorted(candidates):
        groups = parts['nets'][net]
        target = {'net': net, 'domain': 'DOM_LOGIC', 'c05_groups': groups, 'lost_relationships': [{'r07_connected_pad_ids': groups[gi] + groups[gj]}]}
        record = {'net': net, 'before_groups': [groups[gi], groups[gj]], 'nearest_pad_body_gap_mm': distance, 'layers': [], 'paths': []}
        try:
            contacts = model.contact_groups(target)
        except ValueError as exc:
            record.update(verdict='WITHHELD_GRAPH_MISMATCH', reason=str(exc))
            results.append(record)
            continue
        for layer in ['F.Cu', 'B.Cu']:
            if any((layer not in gr['layers'] for gr in contacts)):
                continue
            a, b = [unary_union([r['shape'] for r in gr['records'] if r['layer'] == layer]) for gr in contacts]
            pa, pb = nearest_points(a, b)
            for margin in [4, 14]:
                window = LineString([pa, pb]).envelope.buffer(margin, cap_style=3).envelope
                free, blockers = model.free(target, layer, window)
                ref_layer = S.REF_LAYER[layer]
                free = free.intersection(refs[ref_layer].buffer(-0.125))
                seeds = [S.seed_sites(gr, layer, free, window) for gr in contacts]
                path, search = S.astar(free, seeds[0], seeds[1], time.monotonic() + 5, node_cap=80000) if all(seeds) else (None, {'reason': 'no source-reference-covered attachment', 'nodes': 0})
                record['layers'].append({'layer': layer, 'margin_mm': margin, 'seed_counts': [len(v) for v in seeds], 'search': search})
                if not path:
                    continue
                if not free.covers(LineString(path['points_mm'])):
                    raise ValueError('Rounded emitted path escaped exact free geometry')
                path.update(layer=layer, width_mm=0.2, new_vias=[], reference_layer=ref_layer, source_anchor='J11001.2#0')
                record['paths'].append(path)
                for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(path['points_mm'], path['points_mm'][1:])):
                    r = {'uuid': 'ORDINARY_NEW_' + net + '_' + str(i), 'net': S.norm(net), 'domain': 'DOM_LOGIC', 'kind': 'track', 'shape': LineString([a, b]).buffer(0.1), 'layer': layer, 'key': ('t', 'ORDINARY_NEW_' + net + '_' + str(i)), 'sites': [a, b]}
                    model.records[layer].append(r)
                model.trees[layer] = STRtree([r['shape'] for r in model.records[layer]])
                accepted.append(record)
                break
            if record['paths']:
                break
        record['verdict'] = 'HOST_PATH_NATIVE_OPEN' if record['paths'] else 'NO_PATH_IN_CURRENT_TWO_WINDOWS'
        results.append(record)
        write('progress.json', {'phase': 'RUNNING', 'examined': len(results), 'total_candidates': len(candidates), 'accepted': len(accepted), 'last_net': net, 'last_verdict': record['verdict'], 'elapsed_seconds': time.time() - started})
        write('routes-checkpoint.json', {'board_sha256': g['sha256'], 'results': results, 'native_jobs': 0, 'adopted': False})
        print(net, record['verdict'], flush=True)
    READS.update(S.READS)
    for p, h in READS.items():
        if hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != h:
            raise ValueError('Routing input changed ' + p)
    report = {'board_sha256': g['sha256'], 'source_files_sha256': READS, 'results': results, 'candidate_count': len(candidates), 'accepted_count': len(accepted), 'reference_witnesses': refstats, 'geometry_fresh_native': True, 'actual_via_annuli_used': True, 'track_clearance_mm': 0.15, 'cross_domain_clearance_mm': 0.6, 'hole_clearance_mm': 0.25, 'planning_margin_mm': 0.025, 'no_existing_copper_changes': True, 'new_vias': 0, 'native_drc_run': False, 'board_emitted': False, 'adopted': False, 'limits': ['One shortest relationship per eligible DOM_LOGIC ordinary catalog net in this pass; all enumerated candidates attempted.', 'Two finite windows per layer; failed searches are not global impossibility claims.', 'Frozen router reservations retained.', 'Routes need independent vector/native checks and both-baseline continuity before integration.']}
    write('result.json', report)
    write('progress.json', {'phase': 'COMPLETE', 'accepted': len(accepted), 'examined': len(results), 'elapsed_seconds': time.time() - started})
    print(json.dumps({'accepted': len(accepted), 'examined': len(results), 'result': str(OUT / 'result.json')}), flush=True)
